verdict.rationale: Tilled is an API-first payments platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. However, the evidence only shows a sandbox environment, test card numbers, and a passing mention of a "dev portal" on a custom domain. None of it documents an interactive API reference or runnable, try-it-style examples, and a sandbox environment is an adjacent capability that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
